faqs.question: What is LANA AI?
faqs.answer:
LANA AI is a computer program that helps lawyers do their work. It can read your files, answer questions about them, and help you finish tasks faster. 

The program runs on a computer at your office. This means your files stay private and never leave your building. This is important for keeping client information safe.

faqs.question: How does the AI work?
faqs.answer:
When you ask LANA AI a question, here's what happens:

1. **It searches your files** - LANA AI looks through all your documents to find helpful information
2. **It reads the important parts** - It finds the sections that match your question
3. **It writes an answer** - Using what it found, it gives you an answer

Think of it like having a helper who has read all your files and can quickly find answers for you. The AI runs on a computer in your office, so your files stay private and safe.

faqs.question: How much does LANA AI cost?
faqs.answer:
The price depends on how many people will use it and how much space you need. Each law firm is different, so we create a custom price for you.

To get a price quote, email our sales team at sales@redroostertec.com. They will ask about your firm and give you a fair price.

faqs.question: Who uses LANA AI?
faqs.answer:
LANA AI is used by law firms, company legal teams, and government offices. Our users include small law offices and big law firms. 

Any group that needs to manage and search through legal files can use LANA AI.

categories.title: Getting Started
categories.description: Questions about setup and first steps

faqs.question: How do I log in for the first time?
faqs.answer:
Here's how to get started:

**What you need from your administrator:**
- Organization ID
- Your email address
- Activation code (for first-time users)

**Step 1: Connect to your organization**
- Open LANA AI
- Type your **Organization ID** in the box
- The Server URL fills in automatically
- Click **Connect**

**Step 2: Activate your account (first time only)**
- On the login screen, click **Activate here** at the bottom
- Type your **activation code**
- Type your **email address**
- Create a strong password (at least 8 characters with letters, numbers, and symbols)
- Confirm your password
- Click **Activate**

**Step 3: Log in**
- Type your email address
- Type your password
- Click **Sign in**

**Having problems?** Contact your system administrator for help.

See the Quick Start Guide in the Help section for more details.

faqs.question: What should I do after logging in?
faqs.answer:
Here are the best first steps:

1. **Set up your profile** - Go to Settings and add your name and photo
2. **Create your first case** - Click on 'Matters' and make a new case
3. **Add some files** - Upload documents to your case
4. **Try asking a question** - Go to Chat and ask LANA AI about your files

The Help section has a Quick Start Guide with more details.

faqs.question: How do I upload documents?
faqs.answer:
To add files to LANA AI:

1. **Open a case** - Go to the Matters page and click on a case (create one first if you need to)
2. **Click 'Upload Documents'** - You'll see this button at the top
3. **Choose your files** - Pick files from your computer or drag and drop them
4. **Wait for processing** - LANA AI needs a few minutes to read the files

You can upload PDFs, Word files, Excel sheets, and many other file types. Big files take longer to process.

faqs.question: How do I create a new case?
faqs.answer:
To make a new case:

1. **Click 'Matters'** in the menu on the left
2. **Click 'New Matter'** button
3. **Fill in the details** - Give it a name, add the client name, and pick the case type
4. **Click 'Create'**

Now you can add files to this case. When you ask questions, LANA AI will only look at files from this case.

faqs.question: What file types can I upload?
faqs.answer:
LANA AI can read many file types:

**Documents:** PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Text files (TXT)
**Spreadsheets:** Excel (XLSX, XLS), CSV
**Presentations:** PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT)
**Images:** Pictures with text (PNG, JPG) - LANA AI can read the words in them
**Zip files:** Upload a zip and LANA AI will open it automatically

For best results, use PDFs that have searchable text instead of scanned images.

faqs.question: How long does it take to process files?
faqs.answer:
It depends on the file size:

**Small files** (less than 10 pages): A few seconds
**Medium files** (10-100 pages): 1-3 minutes
**Big files** (more than 100 pages): 5-10 minutes

Scanned PDFs take longer because LANA AI has to read the words from the picture.

You can keep working while your files process in the background.

faqs.question: How do I access LANA AI?
faqs.answer:
Most people use the **desktop app** to access LANA AI:

**On Windows:** Double-click the LanaAI icon on your desktop
**On Mac:** Double-click the LanaAI icon in your Applications folder
**On Linux:** Click the LanaAI icon in your programs menu

The app automatically finds the LANA AI computer in your office. If it can't find it, ask your IT person for help.

Some people can also use a web browser by typing in a special address. Ask your administrator if you need to use it this way.

faqs.question: What can I ask the AI?
faqs.answer:
You can ask LANA AI to help with many tasks:

**Read and summarize:** "Summarize the Smith contract" or "What are the main points?"

**Find information:** "Find all mentions of payment terms" or "What does it say about deadlines?"

**Compare files:** "What changed between version 1 and version 2?"

**Write documents:** "Draft a response letter" or "Create a summary"

**Answer questions:** "What are the client's responsibilities?" or "When is the deadline?"

Always check the AI's answers to make sure they're correct. The AI is a helper tool, not a replacement for your legal judgment.

faqs.question: How does the AI know which files to look at?
faqs.answer:
LANA AI looks at files based on the case you're working on. When you select a case and ask a question, it only searches files in that case.

You can also pick specific files for the AI to read. Click the file drawer icon to choose exactly which files you want the AI to use.

This makes sure the answers match your current work and keeps different cases separate.

faqs.question: Can LANA AI get files from other systems?
faqs.answer:
Yes! LANA AI can automatically get files from:

**Currently available:**
- Microsoft SharePoint
- Google Drive

**Coming soon:**
- OneDrive
- Dropbox
- Box

You can tell LANA AI to check these systems every hour, every day, or every week. It will automatically download new files and make them searchable.

New connections are being added by Red Rooster Technologies. Check the Data Connectors page to see what's available.

faqs.question: Can LANA AI automate my work?
faqs.answer:
Yes! LANA AI can do repetitive tasks automatically:

- Sort and tag files automatically
- Send reminder messages
- Create documents from templates
- Assign tasks to team members
- Take actions based on file content

You can build your own automated workflows or use the ones we've already created. Look for the Workflows section in the menu.

faqs.question: Can I see reports and statistics?
faqs.answer:
Yes! LANA AI shows you helpful information about your work:

- How long cases have been open
- Which team members are working on what
- How many files you've processed
- Storage space being used

Administrators can see reports for the whole office. Regular users can see their own activity.

Look for the Insights section in the menu.

faqs.question: Is my data safe?
faqs.answer:
Yes! Your data is very safe with LANA AI:

**Stays at your office:** All files, cases, and information stay on a computer in your office. Nothing is sent to the internet or cloud services.

**Encrypted:** Your data is scrambled (encrypted) so only you can read it.

**Access controls:** Only people you choose can see each case's files.

**Activity tracking:** The system keeps a record of who looks at what.

Because everything stays at your office, you have complete control over your data. This helps you follow privacy laws and keep client information confidential.

faqs.question: What does 'at your office' mean?
faqs.answer:
LANA AI runs on a computer that sits in your office (usually a Mac Studio). This computer has:

- Your database with all case information
- Your files and documents
- The AI that answers questions

This is different from cloud services where your data is stored somewhere else on the internet.

**Why this matters:**
- Your data never leaves your building
- You follow privacy rules for lawyers
- It works even if the internet is slow or down
- You control who can access it
- It's fast because it's on your local network

**What needs internet:**
The desktop app can download updates from Red Rooster Technologies. The connections to SharePoint and Google Drive need internet. But your actual case files and data stay at your office.

faqs.question: Can I control who sees what?
faqs.answer:
Yes! You have lots of control over who can see files:

**By role:**
- **Admin** - Can see everything and manage users
- **Manager** - Can create cases and assign people
- **User** - Can work on their own cases
- **Viewer** - Can only look, not change anything

**By case:**
You can choose specific people to work on each case. Even if someone is a User, they can only see cases you assign to them.

**Activity log:**
Admins can see who looked at what files and when.

This keeps different cases separate and protects confidential information.

faqs.question: Does LANA AI follow legal industry rules?
faqs.answer:
Yes. LANA AI is built for law firms with privacy in mind:

- Your data stays at your office, following lawyer-client confidentiality rules
- Works with GDPR, HIPAA, and other privacy laws
- Tracks who accesses files for compliance reports
- Encrypts all data
- Gets regular security updates from Red Rooster Technologies

You should still check with your compliance team to make sure it works for your specific needs.

faqs.question: Can I back up my data?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Your IT team should back up the LANA AI computer regularly.

**Default backup:**
Most firms back up to external hard drives or another computer in the office.

**Cloud backup:**
Some firms want to back up to the cloud (like Amazon S3 or Microsoft Azure). This is possible but requires your IT team to set it up. The backups would be encrypted before being sent to the cloud.

Ask your IT team or Red Rooster Technologies for help setting up backups that match your security needs.

faqs.question: How does LANA AI keep different cases separate?
faqs.answer:
LANA AI uses a **case-based security system**. This means:

**Each case is separate:**
- Every file belongs to one specific case
- People can only see files in cases they're assigned to
- When you ask the AI a question, it only looks at files from the current case

**Why this matters:**
- Keeps client information private
- Prevents mixing up different cases
- Follows ethical rules for lawyers
- Stops accidental sharing of confidential information

Even admins normally only see files through the case system. This protects everyone's data.

faqs.question: I forgot my password. What do I do?
faqs.answer:
Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page. If your office has email set up, you'll get a link to create a new password.

If you don't get an email, ask your administrator. They can reset your password from the Admin page.

faqs.question: Why are my uploads slow?
faqs.answer:
Uploads can be slow for a few reasons:

**Network connection:** WiFi is slower than a cable. Try using a network cable if possible.

**File size:** Bigger files take longer.

**Other people using it:** If many people are uploading at once, it takes longer.

**File type:** Scanned PDFs take longer because LANA AI has to read the words from the picture.

Make sure you're connected to the same network as the LANA AI computer. If it's still slow, check the System Status page or ask your administrator.

faqs.question: My connection to SharePoint or Google Drive isn't working. Help!
faqs.answer:
Try these fixes:

**1. Re-authorize:**
Go to Data Connectors and click 're-authorize'. Sign in again. Connections expire after about 2-3 months and need to be renewed.

**2. Check permissions:**
Make sure you have access to the folders you're trying to sync.

**3. Check internet:**
Make sure the LANA AI computer can reach the internet.

**4. Check the service:**
Make sure SharePoint or Google Drive isn't having problems.

You can see detailed error messages on the Sync Status page. If you can't fix it, ask your administrator for help.

faqs.question: The AI gave me a wrong answer. Why?
faqs.answer:
The AI might give wrong answers for several reasons:

**Not enough information:** The AI might not have found the right files. Try selecting specific files using the file drawer.

**Unclear question:** Try being more specific about what you're asking.

**Missing files:** Make sure all the files you need are uploaded and processed.

**Complex question:** The AI might struggle with very complicated legal questions.

**Important reminder:** Always check the AI's answers. Use the AI as a helper and starting point, not as your final answer. Your legal judgment is more important than what the AI says.

faqs.question: I can't find a file I uploaded. Where is it?
faqs.answer:
Try these steps:

1. **Check the right case** - Make sure you're looking in the case where you uploaded it
2. **Use search** - Type the filename or content in the search box
3. **Check if it finished** - Look at upload history to see if it failed
4. **Check permissions** - Make sure you have access to the case
5. **Check if deleted** - Ask an admin to check the activity log

If you still can't find it, ask your administrator for help.

faqs.question: The desktop app can't find the LANA AI computer. What now?
faqs.answer:
If the app can't find the LANA AI computer:

**1. Check your network:**
Make sure you're connected to the office WiFi or network.

**2. Try entering the address manually:**
If auto-discovery doesn't work, you can type in the computer's address. Ask your IT person for the address.

**3. Check with IT:**
The firewall might be blocking the connection. Your IT team can check this.

**4. Restart the app:**
Close the LANA AI app completely and open it again.

If none of this works, contact your administrator or Red Rooster Technologies support.

categories.title: Billing & Your Account
categories.description: Questions about billing and your account

faqs.question: Can I try LANA AI for free?
faqs.answer:
Yes! We offer a 30-day free trial. The trial includes all features with some limits (usually 5-10 people and limited storage).

Email sales@redroostertec.com to request a trial. We can also show you a demo before you try it.

faqs.question: How do I add more people?
faqs.answer:
Administrators can add people from the Admin → Users page. Click 'Add User', enter their information, and assign them a role.

If you need more user licenses than your plan allows, email support@redroostertec.com. User licenses usually come in groups of 5 or 10.

faqs.question: What happens if I run out of space?
faqs.answer:
Your LANA AI computer has a limited amount of space (like 500GB, 1TB, or 2TB). When you get close to full (90%), administrators get a warning.

To get more space:
- Ask your IT team to add more hard drive space to the computer
- Delete old files you don't need anymore
- Contact Red Rooster Technologies for help

The system won't let you upload more files when you're completely full.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade or get more features?
faqs.answer:
Yes! You can change your plan anytime. Email support@redroostertec.com to:

- Add more users
- Get more storage space
- Add new features
- Get AI improvements

Upgrades happen right away. Downgrades usually happen at the end of your billing period.

faqs.question: How can I pay?
faqs.answer:
We accept several payment methods:

- Credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express)
- Bank transfer (ACH)
- Wire transfer for big contracts
- Purchase orders for approved companies

Email billing@redroostertec.com if you have questions about payment.
